correctness.rationale: For all integer d>=2 and positive leg lengths, the Gaussian cone comparison orders the nonright vertex solid angles strictly by inverse leg length. The gnomonic Jacobian (1+||z||^2)^(-d/2) gives the exact unnormalized solid-angle/fullness ratio, with diameter sqrt(a_(1)^2+a_(2)^2). Pointwise strict lower bound and monotone upper envelope, followed by dominated convergence and beta moments, prove the sharp constants and all boundary cases. Independent evaluations give C_2=pi, C_3=24-12sqrt(2), and test trirectangular angle ratios for three explicit unequal leg triples. These checks only corroborate the universal analytic proof.
